info.title: Xlife admin backend
info.description: Backend API designed for administrators to retrieve data.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of post comments. Results can be filtered by comment status.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of comments per page. Maximum value is 100.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of posts. Results can be filtered by status and searched by text.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of posts per page. Maximum value is 100.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of comments for a specific post.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of comments per page. Maximum value is 100.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of reports. Results can be filtered by status, type, and optionally include the report count for the reported user.

parameters.name: withReportCountForReportedUser
parameters.description: Whether to include the total number of reports received by the reported user. Use 1 for true, 0 for false.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of reports per page. Maximum value is 100.

get.description: Returns the total number of reports grouped by report type.
Returns a paginated list of security logs. Results can be filtered by severity.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of security logs per page. Maximum value is 100.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of blocked IP addresses. Results can be filtered by IP address.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Filter blocked IPs by IPv4 address

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of blocked IPs per page. Maximum value is 100.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of blocked phone numbers. Results can be filtered by phone number.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Filter blocked phone numbers by phone

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of blocked phone numbers per page. Maximum value is 100.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of global security settings.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of security settings per page. Maximum value is 100.

description.example: Maximum allowed failed login attempts before blocking access

get.summary: Get user geographical distribution grouped by country

get.description: Returns a paginated list of posts ordered by viral score for a given date range.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of viral posts per page. Maximum value is 100.

200.description: Paginated viral posts for a given date range.

get.summary: Get user growth grouped by period

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Results can be filtered by status, searched by text, and optionally include the user's last known IP.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search users by name, email, or related searchable fields

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of users per page. Maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: withLastIp
parameters.description: Whether to include the user's last known IP address.

get.description: Returns the details of a specific user.
